findings.english_evidence: The uncertainty note specifically refers to 'the preceding command'.
findings.indonesian_evidence: The corresponding note specifically refers to 'perintah sebelumnya'.
findings.explanation: The source supplies an incomplete reported-speech/until construction, but neither an imperative nor evidence fixing any omitted governing material as a command. The note's uncertainty about what that command was does not support its presupposition that the missing material was a command. A missing declarative governing expression is also possible. The translated fragment and the other two uncertainties in this note are not themselves rejected.
findings.required_resolution: Remove the unsupported command diagnosis in both notes, or refer neutrally to an unclear governing expression/linkage. Retain the source fragment and uncertainties about the addressee and instrumental pronoun; do not invent the missing speech.

accepted_source_uncertainties.detail: عندهم has an unidentified plural referent. Both targets preserve 'with them/di sisi mereka', not a remembered 'with their Lord'.
Camphor and Salsabil remain joined as canonical text presents them. No external verse text was substituted.
بإنسان is locally retained as b-insan with uncertain connection. Earth-nature and coldness remain; dryness was not substituted for the anomaly.
The Red celestial association is retained without importing an unstated Mars identification.

The source's only-two-Names assertion and its awkward rank/secret/knowledge/al-mughna sequence remain. Both targets mark the damaged connection and reading rather than reconcile the assertion against the preceding al-Thabit list.
The encompassing/an siwahu/secret/below-it linkage and pronoun referents are uncertain. Retention plus local notes is adequate; no corrected cosmology is required.
The first-person knowledge/standing-by-fa-secret construction is damaged. Both targets preserve negative, exception and complete later Name list while identifying the local defect.

Numeral-context illa huwa is translated literally with no numerical value supplied. Repeated shin-secret wording and the later independent three-marks/three-forms exclusion remain, despite source awkwardness.
Unvocalized الملك supports king/dominion/angel alternatives; both targets retain al-m-l-k with a local note. The subsequent claim that knowledge's rank is last is not repaired to match list position.
The forgiveness fragment has unclear addressee and instrumental referent. Those two local uncertainties are accepted; this acceptance does not cover F01's unsupported command diagnosis.
The singular subject/referent of the two conception/modality negatives is not explicit; [He/it] and [Dia/hal itu] with local notes adequately expose the uncertainty.
The unvocalized glorious epithet's attachment is left open between Possessor and Throne. No familiar quotation reading is imposed.
The wisdom-clause actor is not explicitly named. Both targets expose that uncertainty while keeping the chamberlain/king analogy and lowercase earthly actors.
Illā ala is incomplete as supplied. Both targets retain that anomaly and the final unfinished 'what appears from' rather than repair or complete the source.

summary: Independently compared the complete frozen physical V2 page 109 Arabic directly with each complete target and read the complete style contract. Thirty-nine explicit coverage checks span every source line/clause plus structure and reader integrity. Main translated content is substantively faithful, including all enumerations, associations, negatives, exceptions, repeated claims and canonical anomalies. REWORK is limited to one unsupported grammar diagnosis inside both L63 uncertainty notes (F01); marked source uncertainty elsewhere is accepted, not treated as mistranslation. All five pinned raw hashes matched before and after review. Canonical Arabic, targets, frozen reader and tracker were not edited; only this original hash-bound review artifact was created. This is a review decision, not a tracker approval.
